## M.S. in Program Evaluation & Data Analytics

I created the core courses for the [MS-PEDA program](https://ds4ps.org/ms-prog-eval-data-analytics/courses/) at ASU as its founding director. The source code for each class, including lectures and labs, is on GitHub under an open license through [DS4PS](https://github.com/DS4PS).
